rule: Search records carry only Master text (titles, summaries, governed fields) except the generic source-locator and chronology record wording below, which is controlled interface copy. A chronology event has no governed title of its own, so its record is named by that wording plus its governed period, exactly as the page labels it, and its summary is the governed fact.

source_locator.summary_en: Original-source locator available in the source directory. Open the record to inspect the available source link and its current public-evidence usage, where applicable.
source_locator.summary_ar: يتوفر رابط للمصدر الأصلي في دليل المصادر. افتح السجل للاطلاع على الرابط المتاح واستخدامه الحالي في الأدلة العامة، إن وُجد.
